text:
maya: Morning triage — about 38 open. Top hotspots: 1) embeddings delays (inc-1234), 2) payment webhook 502 spikes, 3) eu-west dedicated region latency. I'm going to push a macro cleanup PR (remove duplicate 'ask-for-logs', tweak wording for customer-facing macros). Need KMS/log access for ACME-42 to pull logs — @alex can you grant?

alex: On it, granting org-level log access to ACME-42. Ping me when PR is up, I'll quick-review :+1:

sam: Taking embeddings queue. Noticed one replica OOM/killed around 03:22 UTC, restarting job now. ETA ~25-40m to drain backlog.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-1234 — Embeddings worker restart loop. Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-1234

jordan: FYI pushed a tiny fix on the webhook retry logic, PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/642 — low-risk patch, added more logging.

tina: For macros, can we make the customer-facing 'request-logs' macro less technical? e.g., "Please share the last 10 lines of the app logs and the request id." Current wording is too opsy.

maya: Good call. Drafting a new macro snippet, will include the wording and the internal debug steps separately.

maya: Macro snippet (customer-facing):
```
We’re sorry for the trouble. Please send the last 10 lines of your application logs and the request id (e.g., req_abc123). If you can’t share logs, tell us the exact time of the failed request and any error message you saw.
```
Internal macro (for support steps):
```
- Check embeddings pod logs: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embeddings --tail=200`
- If OOMs present, escalate to eng-runtime with pod logs attached.
```

alex: Looks good. Also add a note to the macro: "We may request a sanitized log dump for security-sensitive customers." I'll add the KMS grant and update the permissions ticket.

maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/support-macros/pull/19 — added customer wording + internal checklist. @alex for review, @sam for quick validation on steps.

sam: Confirming: restarted the embedding pods, queue is draining, backlog down from ~460 -> ~120. Watching for retries. Will post if anything spikes.

tina: Reviewed macro wording, left a tiny wording nudge in the PR.

alex: Permissions applied and tested. ACME-42 can now upload logs to support-s3.

maya: Thanks team. I'll promote the macro after @alex merges, and I'll include a line in the 11:30 handoff about INC-1234. If queue doesn't stabilize by 40m, we'll schedule a hotfix cadence.

sam: Queue stable for now, closing loop after one stable hour. If anything pops I'll @channel.

ops-bot: Incident INC-1234 updated: status -> monitoring.

maya: Copy. Thanks everyone :heart:
